				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-c220ee4 elementor-widget__width-inherit elementor-widget elementor-widget-heading" data-id="c220ee4" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="heading.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
					<h2 class="elementor-heading-title elementor-size-small">Watamu Beach Cottages</h2>				</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-d9a5476 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="d9a5476" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<p>Watamu Beach Cottages is a beautiful, wildly rustic, coastal property situated in Watamu, Kenya. Our large, beachfront plot is immersed in nature and has so much to offer whilst being on holiday with us &#8211; it&#8217;s a <em>Peaceful Paradise</em>!</p><p>Enjoy the relaxed, tranquil environment of our shady, tree-filled property with lush gardens, laze around the pool or take a stroll down to the glorious, white sands of the unspoiled beach, just a few meters down our private pathway.</p><p>Our many, unique accommodation choices vary, with more budget friendly options set under the shady canopy of forest trees on our property. What makes us unique is we don&#8217;t just offer the standard &#8216;hotel&#8217; style room, we have a variety of different accommodation choices &#8211; we want to ensure each guest has a memorable experience when choosing to stay with us. Enjoy self-catering or B&amp;B options throughout the year, and be sure to give our <strong>Bamba Kofi Snackbar </strong>a try &#8211; this popular eatery is enjoyed exclusively by our guests, where you may order a delicious snack or meal at any time of the day. Our beach resort is family-run, along with our wonderful team of invaluable staff members, who are always on hand to make your stay as comfortable as possible.</p><p>Our homely, beach resort is a peaceful oasis ready to welcome you to enjoy a truly special, once-in-a-lifetime holiday!</p><p><em>This is an ideal destination for beach lovers looking for a family vacation, a romantic getaway or seeking a little active adventure.</em></p>								</div>

									<p class="elementor-icon-box-description">

We encourage our guests to spend their time catching up on any work or to simply relax with a drink.<br>

			</div>
						<div class="elementor-icon-box-content">
									<h3 class="elementor-icon-box-title">
						<span  >
							Viewpoints						</span>
					</h3>
									<p class="elementor-icon-box-description">
						There are four separate viewpoints which we have been built on the edge of the cliff at our beachfront. Relax under the makuti for a spot of shade and take in the spectacular panoramic views of the ocean. Guests love to spend the day here, enjoying the ever changing scene.					</p>
			</div>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-e38a0f5 elementor-position-inline-start elementor-view-default elementor-mobile-position-block-start elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-box" data-id="e38a0f5" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;fadeIn&quot;,&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:80}" data-widget_type="icon-box.default">

			</div>
						<div class="elementor-icon-box-content">
									<h3 class="elementor-icon-box-title">
						<span  >
							Rooftop Lounge						</span>
					</h3>
									<p class="elementor-icon-box-description">
						Who doesn't enjoy a beautiful view? 
There's a special space exclusive to our guests, found up hight at the top of our Clubhouse building. A perfect chill spot away from it all, to enjoy 360° views;  catch the awesome sunsets or just be still and bask in the balmy sea breeze!  Enjoy the privacy and the peacefulness this beautiful space offers.					</p>
			</div>
		</div>
						</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-8c3eafe elementor-position-inline-start elementor-view-default elementor-mobile-position-block-start elementor-invisible elementor-widget elementor-widget-icon-box" data-id="8c3eafe" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-settings="{&quot;_animation&quot;:&quot;fadeIn&quot;,&quot;_animation_delay&quot;:80}" data-widget_type="icon-box.default">

									<h3 class="elementor-icon-box-title">
						<span  >
							Sea Breeze Massage						</span>
					</h3>
									<p class="elementor-icon-box-description">
						Take the opportunity to indulge in a Relaxing Massage with a picturesque ocean view. At the front of our property, we offer a serene and private viewpoint where you can unwind and enjoy a soothing massage. Our goal is to provide you with a tranquil experience, complete with the calming sounds of the ocean and refreshing sea breeze. Choose from our range of massage options and leave feeling recharged and refreshed.					</p>
			</div>
		</div>

						<span  >
							Activities						</span>
					</h3>
									<p class="elementor-icon-box-description">
						Enjoy some fun and laughter with a game of Pétanque at our beach sand communal area. <br>Check out our new Table Tennis area located adjacent to the Snackbar... a great way to have fun with the family.<br>For those wanting to explore around Watamu village and surrounds, we have a couple of E-bikes for hire.<br>For the more adventurous why not try scuba diving with TURTLE DIVE CENTER, offering lessons &amp; equipment? We also have JC KITECHOOL where you can take up kite surfing lessons &amp; enjoy the fun on the beach in front of our resort. 					</p>
			</div>

            <p class="wpsr_add_read_more wpsr_show_less_content" data-num-words-trim="10">Communicatie ging erg makkelijk, alles ging via de app en dan werden al onze wensen snel voldaan. Het hotel doet alles binnen haar macht om hierop in te spelen. 1 nadeel: wij hadden afgesproken met de host, en de beveiliging en dit meerdere gecheckt dat wij ‘s nachts zouden vertrekken voor onze vlucht. Of de poort open was. Uiteindelijk bleek deze dicht te zijn en het personeel in geen velden of wegen te vinden. Hierdoor waren we een half uur vertraagd en erg gestrest vertrokken. Niet wat je wil om 4 uur snachts. Gelukkig heeft de beveiliging van het buurthotel ons geholpen</p>
    </div>            </div>

            <p class="wpsr_add_read_more wpsr_show_less_content" data-num-words-trim="10">The environment is very beautiful, the staff was helpful and friendly, and the host was very responsive. Overall, the place was not what we expected, due construction noise directly outside the Dhow Cottage. There are multiple cottages on the property, and guests are provided whichever one is available, as stated in the description. It was nice relaxing on the elevated beach view beds. The WiFi was unstable, and the water was off for about an hour due to a leaking pipe. The issues were resolved, and the Caretaker, Benjamin, made sure that we were comfortable and had everything we needed. The Snack Bar has delicious food with an amazing hospitable staff. I would highly recommend the Chickpea Curry, which comes with a side of stir fried veggies, and sliced Chapati. The Veg Samosas are also great! If we choose to stay again, hopefully, the construction is completed by that time.</p>

				<div class="elementor-column elementor-col-50 elementor-inner-column elementor-element elementor-element-d542644 elementor-invisible" data-id="d542644" data-element_type="column" data-e-type="column" data-settings="{&quot;animation&quot;:&quot;fadeIn&quot;,&quot;animation_delay&quot;:200}">

						<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-7326ad5 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="7326ad5" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3>How far are the local shops?</h3><p>Watamu Village is 5kms down Turtle Bay Road where you will find all shops, pharmacies, banks, and local stalls. Blue Marmelade, now based at Blue Moon Mall is a well-stocked supermarket which we recommend as a one-stop shop for all your grocery needs. Should you prefer more local prices, you can opt to buy fresh produce at the stalls on the side of the road. </p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-ae72b5d elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="ae72b5d" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3>What is Self-Catering?</h3><p>Self-Catering requires you to supply all the supplies which you will consume or use during your stay. This would include your toiletries, your food and drink and all sanitary supplies, etc. </p><p>Self-catering accommodation is described as self-contained holiday accommodation which has facilities for the guests to prepare their own meals.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-73c245c elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="73c245c" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3><strong>Can I bring my pet?</strong></h3><p>Yes, we welcome guests with pets but please be aware to keep your pet on a leash and supervised at all times. The safety of your animal is solely the owners responsibility.</p>								</div>
				</div>
				<div class="elementor-element elementor-element-b9b66e1 elementor-widget elementor-widget-text-editor" data-id="b9b66e1" data-element_type="widget" data-e-type="widget" data-widget_type="text-editor.default">
				<div class="elementor-widget-container">
									<h3><strong>What happens in an emergency?</strong></h3><p>We have a complete First Aid Kit available to guests if required. A Doctor is on call for any medical emergencies. There is a 24-hour response team with G4S panic buttons located in most units. The response team will assist with ambulances, police, or the fire brigade. </p><p>We have 2 guards on duty at all times, manning the front entrance gate and patrolling the beachfront of our property.  We also have a fire safety station set up in case of a fire.  The safety of our guests is important to us! </p>								</div>
				</div>
